name: @w6w-apps/leexi
description: Read Leexi calls, transcripts and AI summaries, import recordings, manage meeting events and the meeting assistant, and administer users and teams (plus the reseller endpoints).

w6w.longDescription: Leexi is an AI meeting assistant and call recorder for sales and customer-facing teams. This app lists and reads calls and meetings with their transcripts, AI summaries (prompt completions), call topics, tasks and speakers; imports a call from an uploaded recording; reads, edits and deletes call notes; manages meeting events and sends the Leexi assistant to a meeting; administers users and teams; and, with a reseller key, manages client companies, their subscriptions, teams and users.
